definitions.population: 1,000 public base models. Development and three holdout groups remain separate; diagnostic and owner-only models excluded from headline totals.
definitions.supportedTop: At least one specifically supported career in the current Top three.
definitions.degree: At least one bachelor or graduate route in the shared catalog; associate/specialist programs counted separately. A recognized route is not a claim every job requires that degree.
definitions.followup: Two eligible specific interests, one unresolved check or insufficient activity contexts; no recorded No or review hold. Independent of broad correlation; never establishes support.
definitions.exploration: Current production explorationRows059 output excluding every specifically supported career. Candidates may have unknown or conflicting specific answers and never count as supported Top.
definitions.system: Actual current Fieldguide explorer replay. The separate O*NET reference benchmark is not used for these membership counts.
